card.$description: Component-bound tokens for the Card. Most cards use a hairline border + subtle shadow; reach for lifted only when the card is genuinely elevating.

padding.$description: v0.8 — Expanded from 3 sizes to 7 to match audit-dashboard implementation (card.tsx ships none/xs/sm/md/lg/xl/hero). Names align with spacing.md §3 mapping: default = lg (24 px); compact = md (16 px).

md.$description: 16 px — compact-density card (default for compact mode).

lg.$description: 24 px — comfortable-density card (default for comfortable mode).
